strengths.title: Ship services end to end
strengths.text: From the contract and the database schema to tests, the gateway route and the Kubernetes manifest.

strengths.title: Secure by default
strengths.text: Token verification at the gateway and again in every service, roles plus data-level rules, no secrets in logs.

strengths.title: Built to be operated
strengths.text: Health checks, JSON logs with request ids, clear error contracts — so problems are found in minutes, not days.

strengths.title: Clear conventions, shared knowledge
strengths.text: I write down the rules a team agrees on and keep them true, so new teammates are productive fast.

project.name: nest-microservice platform
project.summary: A NestJS microservice platform: KrakenD as the API gateway, Keycloak for identity, REST services with Prisma/PostgreSQL, NATS JetStream events, and Kubernetes for the whole stack. The dashboard of this site is its live client.
points: JWTs verified locally at the gateway and in each service (RS256 + JWKS, no shared secret)
Role-based access plus “only the creator or an admin” ownership rules
At-least-once events: transactional outbox, JetStream and an idempotent inbox
The whole system on Kubernetes via Kustomize, with a production-like local staging over HTTPS
